function.name: get_current_weather
function.description: Retrieves the current weather conditions for a specified city and state. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location for which to get the weather, in the format of 'City, State', such as 'San Francisco, CA' if State for the city exists. 'City, Country' if State for the city doesn't exist.

**Columbia University** | Item | Details | |------|---------| | **Location** | New York City, New York (main campus in Morningside Heights, Manhattan) | | **Founded** | 1754 (originally King's College; renamed Columbia College in 1784; became Columbia University in 1896) | | **Type** | Private Ivy League research university | | **Campus Size** | ~36 acres (Morningside Heights) + additional sites (e.g., Columbia Business School in Midtown, medical center in Upper Manhattan) | | **Student Body** | ~30,000 total (≈12,000 undergraduates, ≈18,000 graduate & professional students) | | **Faculty** | ~2,500 full‑time faculty members | | **Academic Structure** | • Columbia College (undergraduate liberal arts)
• Graduate Schools: Columbia Law School, Columbia Business School, Columbia Engineering, Columbia Journalism School, Columbia School of International and Public Affairs, etc. | | **Notable Programs** | • Journalism (Columbia Journalism School) – Pulitzer Prize‑winning journalism education
• Law (Columbia Law School) – one of the top law schools in the U.S.
• Medicine (Columbia University Vagelos College of Physicians & Surgeons) – highly ranked medical school
• Engineering (Columbia Engineering) – strong emphasis on interdisciplinary research | | **Research Highlights** | • Nobel laureates among faculty and alumni (e.g., 20 Nobel Prize winners)
• Centers: Columbia Climate Institute, Center for Data Science, Columbia Genome Center, etc. | | **Rankings** | • QS World University Rankings 2025: #15 globally
• U.S. News & World Report 2025: #7 national universities (overall) | | **Endowment** | ~$13 billion (2024) | | **Mascot / Nickname** | No official mascot; sports teams called the “Columbia Lions” | | **Alumni** | Notable alumni include Barack Obama, Alexander Hamilton, Andrew Carnegie, Ruth Bader Ginsburg, and many others across politics, business, science, and the arts | **Key Points** 1. **Historic Roots** – Founded during colonial times as King’s College; survived the American Revolution and was renamed after independence. 2. **Ivy League Member** – One of eight Ivy League institutions, known for rigorous academics and selective admissions. 3. **Urban Campus** – Situated in a dense Manhattan neighborhood with close proximity to cultural institutions, museums, and global organizations. 4. **Interdisciplinary Focus** – Emphasizes cross‑disciplinary collaboration through institutes like the Center for Data Science and the Columbia Climate Institute. 5. **Global Impact** – Research output includes significant contributions to climate science, public health, technology, and humanities. Feel free to ask if you’d like more specific details (e.g., tuition costs, admission statistics, or program rankings).
